fields.title: EGP Uganda tender notice record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _mode/_source/_scrapedAt (plus _error/_errorDetail on failures, or _warning on partial results). Field set differs slightly by mode -- 'latest' and 'archived' notices carry listing fields (and, if fetchDetails was on, the enriched description/bid_opening_result); 'detail' records carry only the per-notice detail fields for the requested notice IDs.

_mode.title: Mode
_mode.description: Which run mode produced this record: latest, archived, or detail.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-bid-notices-live-tab (currently open notice), S1-public-bids-archived-ajax (archived notice), S1-notice-detail-page (direct detail-mode fetch), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed fetches -- not_found, invalid_notice_id, or blocked_or_transient.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

notice_id.title: Notice ID
notice_id.description: EGP Uganda's internal numeric notice ID, parsed from the notice's own detail link.

detail_url.title: Detail page URL
detail_url.description: The universal public notice-detail page for this notice ID (https://egpuganda.go.ug/index/<id>_egp).

procurement_ref.title: Procurement reference number
procurement_ref.description: The procuring entity's own tender reference code, e.g. "UCAA/NCONS/2026-2027/00001" (present on 'latest' records; the equivalent field on 'archived' records has the same name).

procuring_entity.title: Procuring entity
procuring_entity.description: The government ministry/agency/authority running this tender ('latest' records only -- the equivalent field on 'archived' records is upstream's own "procurement_name").

procurement_name.title: Procuring entity (archived records)
procurement_name.description: Upstream's own field name for the procuring entity on 'archived' records -- not a typo in this actor, passed through as returned.

category.title: Category
category.description: Procurement category as shown in the listing, e.g. "Non Consultancy Services", "Works", "Supplies", "Consultancy Services" ('latest' records).

subject_of_procurement.title: Subject of procurement (listing, possibly truncated)
subject_of_procurement.description: The tender's subject/title as shown in the listing table -- upstream itself truncates long subjects here with "..."; see full_subject_of_procurement for the untruncated version when fetchDetails is on.

subject_procurement.title: Subject of procurement (archived records)
subject_procurement.description: Upstream's own field name for the tender subject on 'archived' records.

published_date.title: Published date
published_date.description: Date this notice was published ('latest' records).

submission_deadline.title: Submission deadline (archived records)
submission_deadline.description: Upstream's own field name for the submission deadline on 'archived' records.

bid_opening_date.title: Bid opening date
bid_opening_date.description: Date bids were/are scheduled to be opened (archived records).

bid_opening_time.title: Bid opening time
bid_opening_time.description: Time bids were/are scheduled to be opened (archived records).

financial_year.title: Financial year
financial_year.description: Ugandan government financial year this notice belongs to, e.g. "2025-2026" (archived records, where populated by upstream).

body.title: Notice body (archived records)
body.description: Full boilerplate-wrapped invitation text, as returned by the archived-notices API.

notice_type.title: Notice type
notice_type.description: The notice-detail page's own heading (e.g. "Request for Quotation Notice") when fetchDetails is on -- upstream's internal `notice_type` tag (e.g. "bid_notice") on 'archived' listing records shares this same field name.

procurement_ref_detail.title: Procurement reference (from detail page)
procurement_ref_detail.description: Reference number as shown on the notice's own detail page, present when fetchDetails is on or in mode='detail'.

full_subject_of_procurement.title: Full subject of procurement
full_subject_of_procurement.description: The untruncated tender subject/title, read from the notice's own detail page (fetchDetails on, or mode='detail').

description.title: Full description
description.description: The notice's full invitation-to-bid text, read from its detail page (fetchDetails on, or mode='detail').

bid_opening_result.title: Bid opening result
bid_opening_result.description: Opportunistic enrichment, present only once a bid-opening event has been recorded for this notice: procurement_method, bid_opening_datetime, bids_received, and a bidders[] list of {bidder_name_address, submission_date, amount}. Genuinely public transparency data -- who bid, when, and for how much.

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present if fetchDetails was on but the per-notice detail page could not be fetched/parsed -- listing fields are still included.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Set on partial results, e.g. if archived pagination stopped early after a transient error.
